IDENT.title: Automation platform independent multi-agent system for robust networks of production resources in industry 4.0

A_DEFINITION__agent_definition_verbatim.value: No formal definition; agents represent either the physical system itself or an organizational entity (FIPA-derived architecture).
A_DEFINITION__agent_definition_verbatim.evidence_quote: each agent that appears in the network of the manufacturing facilities represents either the physical system itself or an organizational entity

A_DEFINITION__agent_term_used.evidence_quote: MAS can be used to create application-independent I4.0 systems with arbitrary hardware automation platforms.

A_DEFINITION__agent_entity_types.evidence_quote: Such an agent provides diagnosis services (diagnosis agent) or introduces production requests into the system (product agent) across the CPPS network.

B_ARCHITECTURE__has_knowledge_base.evidence_quote: This information model serves as the agents’ knowledge base that can be exchanged using OPC UA.

B_ARCHITECTURE__kb_representation.evidence_quote: the properties of the respective plants are modelled according to the Product Process Resource (PPR) description

B_ARCHITECTURE__decision_mechanism.evidence_quote: In this implementation, the lowest price is the essential criterion for the selection.

B_ARCHITECTURE__decision_scalability_dis.evidence_quote: Modularization of the software in the form of agents with the capability to distribute functionalities makes it possible to scale the network of production facilities.

B_ARCHITECTURE__has_communication_manage.evidence_quote: The Coordination Process, the Communication interface, and the Knowledge Base.

B_ARCHITECTURE__implementation_platform.evidence_quote: The demonstrators were implemented using different platforms (e.g. JADE or C#) and accessibility protocols.

C_MEMORY__memory_historical.evidence_quote: Agents responsible for executing a manufacturing process need detailed knowledge of the configuration of the production unit they control.

C_MEMORY__memory_historical_description.value: Configuration of controlled production unit (PPR model); updated on setup change.
C_MEMORY__memory_historical_description.evidence_quote: The Configuration is updated once the agent detects a change in the setup.

C_MEMORY__memory_realtime.evidence_quote: Agents that do not speak JPP2 subscribe the getOfferMessage-Type directly and call the createOffer-method to post an offer.

C_MEMORY__memory_scope.evidence_quote: Agents with primarily coordinating and monitoring activities need knowledge about other agents and their condition.

C_MEMORY__memory_update_mechanism.evidence_quote: the agents need to constantly follow the modifications to the hardware

C_MEMORY__memory_requirements_stated.evidence_quote: This requires the existence of an appropriate knowledge base when commissioning the agent.

D_COMMUNICATION__comm_protocol.evidence_quote: Communication is handled by a client-socket-based protocol, the JoghurtProduction-Protocol 2 (JPP2)

D_COMMUNICATION__negotiation_mechanism.evidence_quote: The coordinator asks for and selects proposals from participants within the production network.

D_COMMUNICATION__comm_topology.evidence_quote: the use of a central communication platform as part of the communication infrastructure within the production network is advisable

D_COMMUNICATION__handles_comm_failure.evidence_quote: the implementation of redundant communication channels as well as a requestresponse schematic for message exchange increased the overall stability

G_VALIDATION_METRICS__validation_level.evidence_quote: We demonstrated and evaluated the benefit of the approach by integrating different lab size plants from two different research groups at two universities.

G_VALIDATION_METRICS__disruption_types_h.evidence_quote: If a filling station fails at the myYoghurt system, the agent system adjusts the routing of the workpieces

G_VALIDATION_METRICS__system_scale.evidence_quote: each institute has three facilities involved in the production of yoghurt bottles

G_VALIDATION_METRICS__application_domain.evidence_quote: Overall, the production of yoghurt bottles should be considered for the two scenarios.

H_STANDARDS__standards_referenced.evidence_quote: all levels of automation for ISA 95 should be integrated

H_STANDARDS__ontology_used.value: PPR model / VDI 3682 formalized process description (no formal ontology)
H_STANDARDS__ontology_used.evidence_quote: The formalized process description VDI 3683 is used as a means of describing the production capabilities.

H_STANDARDS__interoperability_claimed.evidence_quote: The integration of existing agent systems into a common automation platform was made possible by uniform OPC UA interfaces.

I_DELTA_VS_REFERENCE__features_common_wi.evidence_quote: the order is assigned to a new product agent who coordinates the production, as introduced by (Kovalenko et al., 2019)

I_DELTA_VS_REFERENCE__features_divergent.value: Focus on cross-site interoperability of heterogeneous MASs via OPC UA gateway and central coordinator/DF with price-based offer selection, rather than product-agent-driven exploration.
I_DELTA_VS_REFERENCE__features_divergent.evidence_quote: the concept shows how different and independent automation platforms can be seamlessly connected via OPC UA

I_DELTA_VS_REFERENCE__essential_componen.value: Agent-based CPPS requires AMS, MTS and DF; execution agents require a knowledge base.
I_DELTA_VS_REFERENCE__essential_componen.evidence_quote: An agent-based CPPS requires three basic organizational entities, e.g., for discovery purposes: an agent management system (AMS), a message transport system (MTS) and a directory facilitator (DF)

I_DELTA_VS_REFERENCE__cites_reference_fr.evidence_quote: the order is assigned to a new product agent who coordinates the production, as introduced by (Kovalenko et al., 2019)

I_DELTA_VS_REFERENCE__static_vs_dynamic_.evidence_quote: the MAS allows for online reconfigurations, such as adding or removing parts of a material flow system
